title: Kiran v. State of Uttarakhand & Ors. (WPSB/175/2023 ke saath)
summary: Uttarakhand HC, Division Bench (Acting CJ Manoj Kumar Tiwari aur Justice Vivek Bharti Sharma), 12.11.2024. B.Ed. (Special Education) wale umeedwaron ne TET-1 pass nahi kiya tha. Unhone Assistant Teacher (Special Education), primary ke 25.03.2023 ke executive order ko chunauti di thi.
held: TET-1 NCTE notification ke anusaar zaroori shart hai. Devesh Sharma (2023 SCC OnLine SC 985) aur Navin Kumar (2024 SCC OnLine SC 2360) ke baad B.Ed. primary teacher ke liye kaafi yogyata nahi maani ja sakti. Petitions dismissed.
use: Graduation % ka mudda yahan nahi hai, isliye yeh Sateshwari ke mukhya tark ke khilaaf nahi jaata.
caution: Agar Sateshwari ki niyukti primary (class I–V) mein B.Ed. ke aadhaar par hui hai, to State Devesh Sharma ka tark utha sakti hai (para 8, 10, 16). Niyukti ka level, TET aur training ki sthiti pehle se pakki kar lein.
Para 11 mein State ka tark: NCTE ki 23.08.2010 aur 29.07.2011 ki notifications ke anusaar TET zaroori hai.
bench: Acting CJ Manoj Kumar Tiwari aur Justice Vivek Bharti Sharma (Division Bench)
